title: IN THE E<span class="class-inverted">A<\span>RTH
review: One of those films that is great at building suspense and a mystery, with the promise of seeing something truly unimaginable. But the harsh reality is that such horrors aren't possible to convey through a television screen. The best they can do is keep you on the hook up until that moment, or avoid showing you at all and have the characters look like they have gone convincingly insane. This is a tense journey through the woods where the protagonists meet increasingly crazy hermits during an unspecified early-2020s pandemic. I liked it well enough, and thought the characters reacted particularly realistically for a horror movie situation.
